name: Juuichigatsu no TricK
source:
It’s almost Halloween season! Amari-chan, who works at a flower shop, is super busy!
But her boyfriend K-kun, who's also a host and her shop manager, starts voicing complaints… and the mood gradually worsens…
A Halloween-themed, yandere, pain-in-the-ass boyfriend,
chat-style horror-ish visual novel.
translation:
快到万圣节季节了！在花店工作的阿玛里酱超级忙！
但同时兼任主持人和店长的男友K君却开始抱怨……心情渐渐恶化……
一个万圣节主题的、病态的、令人讨厌的男朋友，
聊天风格的恐怖视觉小说。
